name: Amangiri
insider_take: Amangiri is not just a hotel — it's a masterpiece carved into the raw desert landscape of the American Southwest, where luxury and wilderness exist in perfect harmony.
whats_special: Nestled among the ancient canyon lands of southern Utah, Amangiri is one of the world's most celebrated desert retreats. The architecture is nothing short of breathtaking — the hotel's structures literally wrap around a central rock formation, making the geology itself part of the design. Its 34 suites offer sweeping views of the surrounding mesa, buttes, and canyon walls, while the iconic floating pool pavilion has become one of the most photographed resort images in the world. The property sits at the convergence of five U.S. states (Colorado, Utah, Arizona, New Mexico, and Nevada) and is a gateway to some of America's most iconic natural wonders, including Antelope Canyon, Lake Powell, Monument Valley, and Bryce Canyon.
pro_tip: Book the Aman Signature Journey — a guided sunrise hot air balloon ride over the canyon lands at dawn. The light hitting the red rock formations at first light is an experience that words simply cannot do justice. Reserve well in advance, as spots fill up quickly.
dont_miss: The Amangiri Spa is legendary — over 25,000 square feet of wellness space inspired by the healing traditions of the Navajo people. Don't miss the Mesa treatment , performed on an outdoor platform with nothing but open sky and canyon views above you. After dark, the remote location means virtually zero light pollution — step outside for some of the most stunning stargazing in North America.
pros: Stunning architectural integration with Utah's desert landscape
Exclusive access to world-class adventure activities and spa treatments
Ultra-luxurious suites with private pools and canyon views
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
cons: Remote desert location requires significant travel planning
Ultra-premium pricing reflects exclusive luxury positioning
